surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Goalie Shesterkin scores
paras: Mika Zibanejad opened the scoring for the Rangers on the power play early in the first. Pavel Dorofeyev scored his first goal for the Rangers midway through the period to make it 2-0. Eeli Tolvanen scored his first goal for the Rangers early in the second to make it 3-0. Nikita Kucherov got the Lightning on the board later in the period, and Gabe Perreault made it 4-1 for the Rangers late in the period. Igor Shesterkin added an empty-net goal with two and a half minutes left to make it 5-1. Ilya Mikheyev made his Lightning debut, after two seasons with the Blackhawks, and picked up an assist.
Don’t let the score fool you: the chances were a lot closer than that. Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 20 of 24 for the Lightning.

The Rangers killed all seven Lightning power plays. The Rangers moved to 1-1-0 with a win in their home opener and climbed out of last place in the NHL, while the Lightning fell to 0-1-0, still last in the NHL.

items.text: Oliver Bjorkstrand played his first game against Tampa Bay since leaving, and picked up an assist.
It was the Lightning’s first game of the season.
Mika Zibanejad extended his point streak against Tampa Bay to six games.
